headline: US Approves $2.1 Billion Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine
summary: The United States approved a foreign military sale of Patriot missile systems to Ukraine valued at $2.1 billion.
why: Large defense contract approvals generate significant revenue for prime defense contractors and underline geopolitical commitments in active conflict zones.

impacts.name: Aerospace & Defense
impacts.why: Multibillion-dollar foreign military sales boost order backlogs for defense manufacturers.
